proposition: In the Tuḥfa-yi ʿAlāʾī Ibn Turka says his family has always been Shafiʿi, in a treatise written for a Hanbali patron; and its introduction complains of the harsh treatment he suffered in Herat. As statements to a patron in his years after the 830 trial, these show what he told ʿAlāʾ al-Dīn, not clearly what he held.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka to ʿAlāʾ al-Dīn b. Bāysunghur
mediation.note: the addressee was a Hanbali; Melvin-Koushki does not say the statement is tailored
